members.name: orientation
members.doc: The direction the buttons lay out in.

members.name: attached
members.doc: Joins the buttons, rounding only the group's outer corners.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Marks the group disabled. Its buttons keep their own disabled state.

members.name: role
members.doc: `presentation` names nothing; a group or region needs an accessible name, and without one the group is presentation.
